content.short: Darkblocks encrypts content and controls access via NFTs, storing unlockables on Arweave and enabling cross-chain deployment.
content.description: Darkblocks is a creative decentralized protocol that gives content creators greater control over how their work is distributed and monetized. Each Darkblock functions as an unlockable piece of content that is stored on Arweave and managed via NFTs. The protocol is chain-agnostic, allowing deployment on any blockchain, and it supports rentals so users can access encrypted content for a short period. This design lets creators monetize access while preserving ownership and privacy.
